entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is the third application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No.63/2025 registered at Police Station Shyampur, District Sehore for the offence punishable under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)
(n), 363(3), 384, 506 of the IPC, under Sections 5/6 of the POCSO Act and under Section 67 of the I.T. Act.

The applicant is in jail since 04.05.2025.
2.
Applicant's first and second bail applications have been dismissed as withdrawn vide orders dated 21.08.2025 and 16.10.2025 passed in M.Cr.C.Nos.30880/2025 and 43815/2025 respectively.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that at the time of offence, the victim was more than 16 years of age and she was the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-JBP:8716 2 MCRC-57139-2025 consenting party.
She, on her own volition, visited the spot, and if any act was done, the same shall be considered to have been committed with her own consent.

The applicant's mobile has been recovered but with the challan, no report or photograph have been submitted as alleged by the victim that obscene photographs were sent on the Instagram I.D. of her brother.
From a perusal of the statements of the victim, it is also clear that she was a consenting party.
Trial will take further time to be concluded, hence, the applicant be enlarged on bail.
4. Learned counsel for the objector has opposed the bail application and submitted that the victim was minor, hence, no indulgence is required.

sentences.text:
Learned counsel for the State has also opposed the bail application and has submitted that except the FIR, the victim has also supported the prosecution case in her statement recorded under Section 183 of BNSS before the Court and deposed in favour of the prosecution before the trial Court, hence,
the applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.
6.
Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
7. Looking to the age of the victim and the allegation levelled against the applicant, this Court is not inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
8. Accordingly, this third bail application filed by the applicant is hereby dismissed.

(DEVNARAYAN MISHRA) JUDGE VB*
